question: Why does the author of the passage ask us to forget the history that we were taught at school?

options.text: because the history book taught us that our nation is ancient
because only the modern people can imagine that way
because the history book taught us that there are no ancient nations in the world
because the history book asks us to celebrate festivals which make us believe that our nation is modern

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation:** The passage suggests that the author wants us to forget the history taught at school because it **conveys the idea that our nation is ancient.**
 
• This** aligns with option 1) **which states** that the history book taught us that our nation is ancient.**

Hence the correct answer is '**because the history book taught us that our nation is ancient...**'

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** 

 
• **Why the other options are incorrect:**

 
 
• **Because only the modern people can imagine that way:** This option **does not address **the reason given in the passage for why we should forget the school-taught history.
 
• **Because the history book taught us that there are no ancient nations in the world:** This option **contradicts** the passage's suggestion that the history book taught us about the ancient nature of our nation.
 
• **Because the history book asks us to celebrate festivals which make us believe that our nation is modern:** This option **introduces a new idea** not mentioned in the passage and does not align with the given reason.
